passiveBonuses.desc: All economic technologies cost 30% less to research, enabling faster economic development and allowing the French to invest saved resources into military
Royal Knights are available one age earlier than standard knights for other civilizations, providing early cavalry pressure
All cavalry units deal +30% bonus damage on initial charge attack when engaging from a distance of 5 or more tiles
Buildings constructed near the Town Center or Keeps generate an Influence bonus that increases the gold generation rate of nearby trade buildings by 10%

age2.bonus: All cavalry units train 40% faster globally. Unlocks the Companion Cavalry technology that provides a free squire (light cavalry) whenever a Royal Knight is trained
All economic and military technologies cost an additional 25% less (stacks with the base economic discount). Researching a technology triggers a 30-second productivity boost to nearby villagers

age3.bonus: Unlocks Ribauldequin (multi-barrel cannon) earlier than standard. All gunpowder units are trained 25% faster and gain +10% projectile speed
Fortified palace that acts as an additional Town Center. Generates 0.5 gold per second and allows training of all Age 3 cavalry units without a separate Stable

age4.bonus: Massive fortress that trains all unit types and provides a garrison capacity of 50. Emits an influence aura that provides +20% attack speed to all units within 15 tiles
Generates resources based on the number of unique building types constructed: +1 food, gold, and wood per second per 5 distinct building types. Encourages diverse base building

uniqueUnits.special: Available from Age 1 (Dark Age). Deals +30% bonus charge damage. Can be upgraded to Veteran Royal Knight and Elite Royal Knight. Inspires nearby cavalry units with +10% speed aura
Elite French crossbowman. Has a Pavise ability that deploys a shield granting +5 armor while stationary. Deals bonus damage to heavy infantry
Multi-barrel organ gun that fires a spread of 5 bolts simultaneously in a cone. Devastating against massed infantry. Very slow movement speed and requires a crew of 2 to operate
Elite cavalry champion available only in Age 4. Immune to negative auras. Every 5th attack triggers a Rally Cry that grants all nearby cavalry +25% attack speed for 8 seconds

uniqueTech.effect: Stables generate 1 food per second and Royal Knights regenerate 2 HP per second passively out of combat, reflecting the disciplined French knight culture
All cavalry units gain +15% HP and a charge distance of +2 tiles. Increases the bonus damage window for the Cavalry Charge passive
All French military units are considered 'standing army' and gain +10% attack and +5% move speed. Additionally reduces cavalry training cost by 20%
